description: The overlay webview: listen to pushes (pill, sessions, inbox, notes, agenda, display, settings, health, quiet, hotkey.fired, overlay.pointer, alert.fired), emit to the core, the session commands (decide, acknowledge, dismiss, jump, snooze), overlay_request / overlay_measure, app_open, health_get, the overlay's notes set (capture, dropped links, set a field, cycle a status, prepare notes; 08 §5.3), and its connectors set: inbox row triage (mark read, archive, snooze), open in source and join (the core opens the link), withdrawing an alert, the status item's pause (quiet_set), the theme token map (theme_resolve, applied like the app window's), the command palette query (palette_query) and dictation's in-window path (dictation_status, press / release / cancel, dictation_inserted after a dictation.text, app_context_set with the open panel's item; XC-37, XC-38; dictation_say, which only a dev build routes, 08 §12), the Now playing strip's controls (media_play_pause, media_next, media_previous, media_open; OV-37) and the Music tab's history and rows (media_history, media_play; ADR-0066). No window geometry (the core shows, sizes and moves the overlay), no settings writes, no plugins, no hook install.
